title: Uniform annihilator bound for a principal section
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, meaning a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let g be in Gamma(X,O_X). There exists c in the natural numbers such that for every open V of X, every natural k, and every s in Gamma(V,O_X), the equality (g|V)^k s=0 implies (g|V)^c s=0.

source.place: Tag 01YB, second paragraph (stabilization of power annihilators), with Tags 01PO and 01Y8.

proof.text: For a Noetherian ring A and g in A, apply monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian to the increasing submodules ker(multiplication by g^k). If c is the stabilization index, all kernels lie in the cth kernel: use stabilization for k at least c and monotonicity for k at most c.

This bound survives every localization A to B. Write a section s of B with denominator d and numerator a. If g^k s=0, IsLocalization.exists_of_eq gives a denominator e with e*g^k*a=0 in A. The bound in A kills e*a by g^c. Map back to B and cancel the units e and d to get g^c s=0.

Compactness and the affine-open basis give a finite affine cover of X. Choose a stabilization exponent on each chart and let c be their finite maximum. Increase the chart bounds to c by multiplying by a further power of g.

For an open V and a section s killed by g^k, refine its intersection with the finite affine cover by basic opens. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_basicOpen and the preceding localization calculation show that g^c s restricts to zero on every such basic open. Sheaf separatedness gives g^c s=0 on V. Empty X and V are included by the empty-cover case.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_principal_section_stable_annihilator
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (V : X.Opens) (k : ℕ) (s : Γ(X, V)),
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op g) ^ k * s = 0 →
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op g) ^ c * s = 0
